items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I introduced Nat and I introduced Buck to Billy Rose and I started talking about the show and the possibilities of Buck and I going in the show, we ain't doing nothing and I got the contract.

ctx.x: So the next day I got the appointment for 3 o'clock. So I call up the next day to the office and tell Nazarro I've got an appointment for us for 3 o'clock this afternoon with Billy Rose. Okay. You don't tell me he's got any kind of a job or nothing, you know that. Billy Rose tells me that, you know. He told me that the next day because he says to me, he says, he told me you were booked up and you were busy and he sent Heckle and Jive the book and over. I gave them the script. I said, "Did ya? I said, "We've got…

Okay. When I get Nazarro and Buck over to his office, Billy Rose office in the Ziegfeld Theater, that's where his office was, we get in his office and Buck and Nazarro didn't say a word 'cause I did all the talking. I introduced Nat and I introduced Buck to Billy Rose and I started talking about the show and the possibilities of Buck and I going in the show, we ain't doing nothing and I got the contract.

All he had to do is okay the contract, sign the contract, that's all I let him do. Sing the contract, we were going in the show. That's how I got in "Carmen Jones." I got in the Ziegfeld Follies almost the same way. However, so we go get the contract signed, go in the show and success in the show, okay? Then this is 1931, I think it is -- 1930 --
